headline: Motor & General Finance informs exchange about postal ballot notice
hook: Postal ballot notice sent to shareholders
summary: The Motor & General Finance Limited has formally notified the stock exchange regarding the issuance of a postal ballot notice for its shareholders. The filing is a procedural corporate exercise required for conducting remote voting on upcoming resolutions. Retail investors holding shares in the company will receive the ballot details to participate in decision-making. Such filings are routine corporate governance events that do not directly alter the company's financial valuation or near-term share price.
why_it_matters: Routine governance update with no direct impact on share price.

headline: Motor & General Finance reports board meeting outcome
hook: Routine board meeting update from Motor & General Finance
summary: The Motor & General Finance Limited has formally informed the stock exchange about the outcome of its board meeting held on October 19, 2026. Such procedural filings are a standard regulatory requirement for listed entities. This disclosure contains no operational updates, financial results, or corporate actions. Indian retail investors holding this micro-cap stock should note the lack of immediate price-sensitive catalysts in this filing.
why_it_matters: No immediate impact on shareholder value from this procedural filing.
